ticket.summary: Bulk shipment creation for selected orders
ticket.description:
As a seller I can select several orders on the Orders page and create shipments for all of them in one action.

Rules:
- At most 100 orders can be selected for one bulk action. Selecting more shows an error and nothing is created.
- Each order uses the courier rate that was selected for it. Orders without a selected rate are skipped.
- Orders whose Ship To address is invalid are skipped and listed in a result summary with the reason.
- When the courier service is unavailable, no shipment is created for the failed orders and the seller can retry them.
- After the action, a summary shows how many shipments were created and how many were skipped or failed.
ticket.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Selecting 1 to 100 orders and clicking Create shipments creates one shipment per eligible order.
2. Selecting 101 orders shows the error "You can create shipments for up to 100 orders at a time" and creates nothing.
3. Orders with no selected rate or an invalid address are skipped and appear in the summary with a reason.
4. A courier outage leaves failed orders without shipments and shows a Retry action.

reference.title: Create shipments for several selected orders with rates
reference.expected: One shipment is created per selected order and the summary shows the count
